__default__.what_measures: Primary summary metric for the selected family and current contractual view.
__default__.price_relation: Its effect on Price depends on the surrounding liquidity, positioning, volatility and market structure.
__default__.cross_family_relation: Use this KPI together with the other families instead of reading it in isolation.
__default__.interpretation: Higher or lower is not automatically bullish or bearish; the family context matters.

__default__.what_measures: Primary family visualization used to inspect the main state variables of the contract.
__default__.price_relation: Shows the local mechanism that can influence Price, but not a standalone forecast.
__default__.cross_family_relation: Corroborate with companion families before forming a directional view.
__default__.interpretation: Read this panel as structural context for the family.

__default__.what_measures: Derived analysis block computed from the family inputs and classification layers.
__default__.price_relation: Helps explain Price behavior through a focused analytic lens.
__default__.cross_family_relation: Designed to connect the family with liquidity, volatility, positioning or on-chain context.
__default__.interpretation: Best used for confirmation and regime reading rather than as a standalone signal.

last_price.what_measures: Latest contract price for the selected market and timeframe.
last_price.price_relation: It is the anchor variable of the whole platform.
last_price.cross_family_relation: All divergence, regime and pressure families reference Price behavior.
last_price.interpretation: Use it as the current reference level, not as a trend conclusion.

high_24h.what_measures: Maximum traded price during the last 24 hours.
high_24h.price_relation: Defines the recent upper extreme visited by Price.
high_24h.cross_family_relation: Useful when comparing breakout pressure with CVD, OI or liquidation clusters.
high_24h.interpretation: A nearby retest can matter more than the absolute value.

low_24h.what_measures: Minimum traded price during the last 24 hours.
low_24h.price_relation: Defines the recent lower extreme visited by Price.
low_24h.cross_family_relation: Helps contrast downside tests with sell pressure, liquidations and depth conditions.
low_24h.interpretation: Watch whether other families confirm or reject revisits of this low.

change_24h.what_measures: Net percentage price change over the last 24 hours.
change_24h.cross_family_relation: A strong change with weak participation or fragile liquidity can be less reliable.
change_24h.interpretation: Magnitude matters, but so do the drivers behind it.

volume_24h.what_measures: Total traded volume over the last 24 hours.
volume_24h.price_relation: Higher volume often means stronger participation behind Price movement.
volume_24h.cross_family_relation: Compare with CVD to understand whether execution was buy- or sell-dominant.
volume_24h.interpretation: Rising Price on weak volume can signal fragile conviction.

market_cap.price_relation: Scales the asset and contextualizes how much capital underlies Price.
market_cap.cross_family_relation: Useful for broad regime context rather than intraday trading mechanics.
market_cap.interpretation: More useful as macro context than as a trigger.

volatility_atr_percent.what_measures: ATR normalized by Price, expressing current trading range intensity.
volatility_atr_percent.price_relation: Higher ATR percent means Price is traveling more per bar.
volatility_atr_percent.cross_family_relation: Connect it with Volatility and Liquidations to judge instability.
volatility_atr_percent.interpretation: Useful for risk framing, not direction by itself.

average_range.what_measures: Average price range over the selected lookback window.
average_range.price_relation: Captures typical local amplitude of Price movement.
average_range.cross_family_relation: A widening range with crowding or liquidations can foreshadow stress.
average_range.interpretation: Helps size expected motion and stops.

beta.what_measures: Sensitivity of the instrument versus its chosen benchmark.
beta.price_relation: Shows how strongly Price tends to react relative to that benchmark.
beta.interpretation: Higher beta means more benchmark-linked variability.

rsi.what_measures: Relative strength of recent gains versus losses.
rsi.price_relation: RSI describes the internal momentum of Price and highlights stretched momentum states.
rsi.cross_family_relation: CVD can confirm whether RSI strength is supported by aggressive flow; Liquidity helps judge whether extremes can persist.
rsi.interpretation: High/low readings mean stretched momentum, not an automatic reversal.

macd.what_measures: Trend-following momentum from the MACD line, signal line and histogram.
macd.price_relation: A widening positive MACD structure supports upward Price momentum; a widening negative structure supports downward momentum.
macd.cross_family_relation: Confirm with CVD for execution, OI for exposure expansion and Volatility for regime strength.
macd.interpretation: Use crossovers and histogram expansion as momentum evidence, not as standalone causality.

stochastic.what_measures: Location of Price inside its recent high-low range using %K and %D.
stochastic.price_relation: Shows short-term range pressure and local momentum exhaustion.
stochastic.cross_family_relation: Liquidity walls and support/resistance help determine whether an extreme can hold or break.
stochastic.interpretation: Overbought/oversold readings are contextual; crossovers matter more near structural levels.

adx.what_measures: Trend strength together with +DI and -DI directional components.
adx.price_relation: ADX measures how strongly Price is trending; +DI/-DI indicate which directional component dominates.
adx.cross_family_relation: Use CVD/OI to test whether a strong trend has flow and exposure support.
adx.interpretation: High ADX means strong trend conditions, not bullishness by itself.

cci.what_measures: Deviation of typical Price from its moving statistical baseline.
cci.price_relation: Large absolute CCI values indicate Price is displaced from its recent mean.
cci.cross_family_relation: Useful with Volatility and support/resistance to distinguish trend extension from mean-reversion conditions.
cci.interpretation: Treat extremes as extension context; direction still requires confirmation.

mfi.what_measures: Volume-weighted momentum combining Price movement and traded volume.
mfi.price_relation: Shows whether Price pressure is accompanied by stronger or weaker money-flow participation.
mfi.cross_family_relation: CVD provides the more direct aggressive-execution view; MFI remains a Price/volume transformation.
mfi.interpretation: Useful for participation confirmation and divergence, not as a substitute for CVD.

williams_r.what_measures: Fast oscillator measuring where Price closes within its recent range.
williams_r.price_relation: Highlights short-term Price extension near recent highs or lows.
williams_r.cross_family_relation: Combine with Liquidity and CVD to distinguish absorption from continuation.
williams_r.interpretation: Extreme readings signal stretch, not a deterministic reversal.

atr.what_measures: Average True Range, the recent absolute amplitude of Price movement.
atr.price_relation: Higher ATR means Price is traversing a wider range per bar.
atr.cross_family_relation: Compare with Volatility, Liquidations and Liquidity stress for risk sizing.
atr.interpretation: ATR measures movement magnitude, not direction.

tsi.what_measures: Double-smoothed Price momentum designed to reduce short-term noise.
tsi.price_relation: TSI tracks persistent direction and momentum changes in Price.
tsi.cross_family_relation: Best confirmed with CVD direction and OI participation.
tsi.interpretation: Signal-line crosses and zero-line behavior describe momentum transitions rather than guaranteed entries.

bollinger_band_width.what_measures: Width of the Bollinger envelope, used as a compression/expansion measure.
bollinger_band_width.price_relation: Narrow width means compressed Price dispersion; expanding width means movement is broadening.
bollinger_band_width.cross_family_relation: Volatility confirms the broader regime while Liquidity can explain whether expansion occurs through thin structure.
bollinger_band_width.interpretation: Compression can precede expansion but does not determine direction.

wasserstein_distance.what_measures: Distributional distance between the current Price-feature regime and its reference distribution.
wasserstein_distance.price_relation: A rising distance means Price behavior is becoming statistically less similar to the reference regime.
wasserstein_distance.cross_family_relation: Use with Volatility regime shift and cross-family Wasserstein measures to detect broader state transitions.
wasserstein_distance.interpretation: Interpret as regime displacement, not directional prediction.

price_ohlcv.title: Prices · OHLCV Structure
price_ohlcv.what_measures: Canonical BTC price structure with OHLCV and the selected Price-family overlays.
price_ohlcv.price_relation: This is Price itself: the base observable used by the rest of TradELATIN.
price_ohlcv.cross_family_relation: CVD explains aggressive execution, OI explains derivatives exposure, Liquidations forced deleveraging, and Liquidity the depth Price encounters.
price_ohlcv.interpretation: Use this panel to locate trend, structural levels and price displacement before interpreting the other families.

cvd_slope_acceleration.what_measures: Slope and acceleration of Spot or Futures CVD.
cvd_slope_acceleration.price_relation: Slope shows the direction of aggressive-flow accumulation; acceleration shows whether that pressure is strengthening or weakening behind Price.
cvd_slope_acceleration.cross_family_relation: Liquidity determines whether the aggression is absorbed; OI shows whether derivatives exposure expands with it.
cvd_slope_acceleration.interpretation: Strong slope plus acceleration is stronger flow evidence than CVD level alone.

delta_zscore.what_measures: Standardized Volume Delta relative to its recent distribution.
delta_zscore.price_relation: Large positive/negative Z-scores identify unusually strong buy/sell aggression that may influence Price.
delta_zscore.cross_family_relation: Liquidations can explain extreme forced-flow observations; Liquidity determines their Price impact.
delta_zscore.interpretation: Focus on magnitude and sign: abnormal does not automatically mean reversal.

buy_sell_imbalance.what_measures: Normalized dominance of aggressive buy versus sell execution.
buy_sell_imbalance.price_relation: Positive imbalance favors buy-side pressure on Price; negative imbalance favors sell-side pressure.
buy_sell_imbalance.cross_family_relation: Order-book depth and absorption determine whether the imbalance translates into Price displacement.
buy_sell_imbalance.interpretation: This is executed-flow imbalance, not resting-order imbalance.

price_cvd_divergence.what_measures: Directional mismatch between Price and CVD.
price_cvd_divergence.price_relation: Price rising while CVD weakens, or Price falling while CVD strengthens, signals reduced flow confirmation.
price_cvd_divergence.cross_family_relation: OI helps separate genuine divergence from deleveraging; Liquidity can explain absorption.
price_cvd_divergence.interpretation: A divergence is a warning/confirmation tool, not a guaranteed reversal.

spot_futures_divergence.what_measures: Divergence between Spot CVD and Futures/Perpetual CVD.
spot_futures_divergence.price_relation: Shows whether spot execution and leveraged derivatives execution are confirming the same Price move.
spot_futures_divergence.cross_family_relation: Funding and OI reveal whether the futures side is crowded or expanding.
spot_futures_divergence.interpretation: Persistent divergence can indicate unstable price discovery or derivatives-led movement.

wasserstein_distance.what_measures: Distributional distance between the current CVD/flow regime and its reference state.
wasserstein_distance.price_relation: Higher distance means the execution-flow environment around Price has shifted materially.
wasserstein_distance.cross_family_relation: Compare with Volatility and Liquidity regime shifts for cross-family confirmation.
wasserstein_distance.interpretation: Use as regime-change evidence rather than a directional signal.

delta_1h.title: Delta 1H
delta_1h.what_measures: Net aggressive buy volume minus aggressive sell volume in the latest 1-hour window.
delta_1h.price_relation: Positive Delta means buy aggression dominated; negative Delta means sell aggression dominated.
delta_1h.cross_family_relation: Liquidity determines how strongly that aggression moves Price; Liquidations can create forced aggressive flow.
delta_1h.interpretation: Read the sign together with CVD slope and Price response.

buy_sell_ratio_1h.title: Buy / Sell Ratio
buy_sell_ratio_1h.what_measures: Ratio of aggressive buy volume to aggressive sell volume.
buy_sell_ratio_1h.price_relation: Values above 1 favor buy-side aggression; below 1 favor sell-side aggression.
buy_sell_ratio_1h.cross_family_relation: OFI expresses the same balance on a bounded scale; Flow Efficiency adds local directional intensity.
buy_sell_ratio_1h.interpretation: It measures side dominance, not guaranteed Price direction.

futures_vs_spot_volume_ratio_1h.title: Futures vs Spot Volume Ratio
futures_vs_spot_volume_ratio_1h.what_measures: Relative executed participation in Futures versus Spot.
futures_vs_spot_volume_ratio_1h.price_relation: Shows where execution is concentrated around a Price move, not whether Price should rise or fall.
futures_vs_spot_volume_ratio_1h.cross_family_relation: Combine with Spot ↔ Futures CVD Divergence and OI/Funding.

flow_efficiency_1h.title: Flow Efficiency
flow_efficiency_1h.what_measures: Local one-sided execution intensity before opposing subintervals cancel at the aggregate level.
flow_efficiency_1h.price_relation: High efficiency means execution is locally directional, but Price impact still depends on liquidity.
flow_efficiency_1h.cross_family_relation: Use with OFI to distinguish quiet balance from intense two-sided competition.
flow_efficiency_1h.interpretation: High FE with near-zero OFI can mean strong alternating aggression.

vwap_1h.title: VWAP 1H
vwap_1h.what_measures: Volume-weighted average execution price during the latest hour.
vwap_1h.price_relation: Provides the execution-price reference where most traded volume occurred.
vwap_1h.cross_family_relation: Compare current Price with VWAP and CVD to judge whether aggressive flow is being accepted or rejected.
vwap_1h.interpretation: VWAP is a reference price, not an aggressor-direction metric.

order_flow_imbalance_1h.title: Order Flow Imbalance
order_flow_imbalance_1h.what_measures: Bounded normalization of aggressive buy-versus-sell executed volume.
order_flow_imbalance_1h.price_relation: Positive values indicate buy aggression dominance; negative values indicate sell aggression dominance.
order_flow_imbalance_1h.cross_family_relation: Liquidity explains whether this pressure is absorbed or transmitted into Price.
order_flow_imbalance_1h.interpretation: Near zero can mean balance or intense two-sided activity; use Flow Efficiency for context.

cvd_spot.title: CVD Spot
cvd_spot.what_measures: Cumulative aggressive executed imbalance in the Spot market.
cvd_spot.price_relation: Shows the execution pressure occurring around Price without assuming one-to-one Price response.
cvd_spot.cross_family_relation: Liquidity determines absorption and impact; OI/Funding adds derivatives exposure context.
cvd_spot.interpretation: Spot and Futures remain separate processes; compare them instead of summing them into a synthetic General CVD.

cvd_futures.title: CVD Futures / Perpetuals
cvd_futures.what_measures: Cumulative aggressive executed imbalance in Futures/Perpetuals.
cvd_futures.price_relation: Shows the execution pressure occurring around Price without assuming one-to-one Price response.
cvd_futures.cross_family_relation: Liquidity determines absorption and impact; OI/Funding adds derivatives exposure context.
cvd_futures.interpretation: Spot and Futures remain separate processes; compare them instead of summing them into a synthetic General CVD.

delta_buy_sell_spot.title: Spot Buy / Sell Delta
delta_buy_sell_spot.what_measures: Executed aggressive buy and sell flow for Spot.
delta_buy_sell_spot.price_relation: Shows the execution pressure occurring around Price without assuming one-to-one Price response.
delta_buy_sell_spot.cross_family_relation: Liquidity determines absorption and impact; OI/Funding adds derivatives exposure context.
delta_buy_sell_spot.interpretation: Spot and Futures remain separate processes; compare them instead of summing them into a synthetic General CVD.

delta_buy_sell_futures.title: Futures Buy / Sell Delta
delta_buy_sell_futures.what_measures: Executed aggressive buy and sell flow for Futures/Perpetuals.
delta_buy_sell_futures.price_relation: Shows the execution pressure occurring around Price without assuming one-to-one Price response.
delta_buy_sell_futures.cross_family_relation: Liquidity determines absorption and impact; OI/Funding adds derivatives exposure context.
delta_buy_sell_futures.interpretation: Spot and Futures remain separate processes; compare them instead of summing them into a synthetic General CVD.

open_interest_usd.what_measures: Total notional open interest in derivatives.
open_interest_usd.price_relation: Rising OI can signal increasing participation behind Price movement.
open_interest_usd.cross_family_relation: Funding and Liquidations clarify whether that exposure is crowded or stable.
open_interest_usd.interpretation: Higher OI is not inherently bullish or bearish.

oi_change_24h.price_relation: Shows how rapidly derivatives exposure is expanding or contracting.
oi_change_24h.cross_family_relation: Compare with Price and CVD to distinguish fresh trend participation from deleveraging.
oi_change_24h.interpretation: Direction gains meaning only together with Price behavior.

oi_funding_state.what_measures: Joint state summarizing open interest and funding conditions.
oi_funding_state.price_relation: Helps explain whether Price is advancing in a crowded long or short environment.
oi_funding_state.cross_family_relation: Pairs naturally with Liquidations and CVD.
oi_funding_state.interpretation: This is a regime label, not a raw market datum.

provider_availability.what_measures: Data quality and provider coverage condition.
provider_availability.price_relation: It does not move Price; it tells you how reliable the displayed derivatives state is.
provider_availability.cross_family_relation: Treat it as data-quality context shared with the other families.
provider_availability.interpretation: Lower availability means more caution when interpreting the panel.

funding_rate.what_measures: Perpetual funding transfer rate between longs and shorts.
funding_rate.price_relation: Shows which side of Price exposure is paying to maintain leverage.
funding_rate.cross_family_relation: Combining funding with OI and Liquidations reveals crowding risk.
funding_rate.interpretation: Extremes can signal expensive directional positioning.

estimated_leverage_ratio.what_measures: Approximate leverage intensity of derivatives positioning.
estimated_leverage_ratio.price_relation: Higher leverage increases the chance that Price shocks trigger liquidations.
estimated_leverage_ratio.cross_family_relation: Very relevant to Liquidations and Volatility.
estimated_leverage_ratio.interpretation: High ELR means a more fragile leveraged state.

oi_zscore_percentile.what_measures: Z-score and historical percentile of current Open Interest.
oi_zscore_percentile.price_relation: Identifies unusually crowded or unusually light derivatives exposure around Price.
oi_zscore_percentile.cross_family_relation: Funding and Liquidations determine whether elevated OI is fragile.
oi_zscore_percentile.interpretation: High percentile means high exposure versus its own history, not bullishness.

price_oi_regime.what_measures: Joint classification of Price direction and Open Interest direction.
price_oi_regime.price_relation: Separates expansion from deleveraging/covering: Price↑+OI↑, Price↓+OI↑, Price↑+OI↓, Price↓+OI↓.
price_oi_regime.cross_family_relation: CVD adds executed-flow confirmation and Liquidations identify forced removal when present.
price_oi_regime.interpretation: This regime summarizes interaction; it does not infer liquidations from OI decline.

price_oi_divergence.what_measures: Divergence between Price movement and Open Interest behavior.
price_oi_divergence.price_relation: Highlights Price movement that lacks equivalent participation from derivatives exposure.
price_oi_divergence.cross_family_relation: CVD and Liquidity help judge whether the move is spot-led, absorbed or structurally fragile.
price_oi_divergence.interpretation: Treat divergence as confirmation/risk context, not a standalone trigger.

funding_oi_crowding.what_measures: Combined crowding state from Funding and Open Interest.
funding_oi_crowding.price_relation: Shows when Price is surrounded by expensive and concentrated leveraged positioning.
funding_oi_crowding.cross_family_relation: Liquidations become more relevant when crowding is high; CVD shows current execution pressure.
funding_oi_crowding.interpretation: Crowding increases squeeze/flush fragility but does not predict direction.

wasserstein_distance.what_measures: Distributional distance between current derivatives positioning and the reference OI/Funding regime.
wasserstein_distance.price_relation: Higher distance indicates the exposure environment around Price is changing structurally.
wasserstein_distance.cross_family_relation: Use with Volatility and Liquidations regime shifts for confirmation.
wasserstein_distance.interpretation: A regime-shift metric, not a directional forecast.

oi_dynamics.what_measures: Rate of change, slope and acceleration of Open Interest.
oi_dynamics.price_relation: Shows whether derivatives exposure around Price is expanding, contracting, accelerating or decelerating.
oi_dynamics.cross_family_relation: Price direction, CVD and Funding determine whether that exposure represents trend participation, covering or deleveraging.
oi_dynamics.interpretation: OI dynamics measure participation change; OI down does not equal liquidation.

open_interest_ohlc.title: Open Interest OHLC
open_interest_ohlc.what_measures: Internal evolution of open derivatives exposure aggregated as OHLC, with OI-specific structural overlays.
open_interest_ohlc.price_relation: OI does not encode direction by itself; its meaning comes from how exposure changes while Price moves.
open_interest_ohlc.cross_family_relation: Funding adds positioning cost, CVD execution pressure and Liquidations forced exposure removal.
open_interest_ohlc.interpretation: Price up + OI up differs structurally from Price up + OI down.

etf_flow_daily.what_measures: Aggregate daily ETF net flow entering or leaving the monitored products.
etf_flow_daily.price_relation: Persistent positive ETF flow can support Price through institutional allocation demand.
etf_flow_daily.cross_family_relation: Compare with Exchange Flows to distinguish capital allocation from coin transfer activity.
etf_flow_daily.interpretation: Positive means net inflow; negative means net outflow.

exchange_net_flow.what_measures: Observed BTC inflows, outflows and net flow across exchanges.
exchange_net_flow.price_relation: Exchange transfers can change available sell-side or accumulation context around Price.
exchange_net_flow.cross_family_relation: Do not confuse with ETF flows or CVD execution flow.
exchange_net_flow.interpretation: Net inflow and net outflow have different macro implications depending on regime.

exchange_balance.what_measures: Stock of BTC held on monitored exchanges.
exchange_balance.price_relation: Reserve expansion or contraction can influence perceived sell-side availability for Price.
exchange_balance.cross_family_relation: Complements on-chain treasury movement and ETF demand.
exchange_balance.interpretation: Use trends and changes, not single values alone.

etf-funds.title: ETF Flow by Provider / Fund
etf-funds.what_measures: Decomposition of ETF allocation across the observed products/providers.
etf-funds.price_relation: Shows which vehicles contribute to the institutional allocation backdrop around Price.
etf-funds.cross_family_relation: Aggregate ETF Net Flow combines these product-level flows; CVD and Liquidity show how market execution responds.
etf-funds.interpretation: Use the table to identify concentration, dispersion and sign differences across funds.

etf_flow_momentum_persistence.what_measures: Momentum and persistence of ETF net capital flows.
etf_flow_momentum_persistence.price_relation: Persistent positive allocation can support Price demand; persistent negative allocation can remove that support.
etf_flow_momentum_persistence.cross_family_relation: Exchange reserve/flow shows BTC inventory movement while Liquidity shows how flows can be transmitted into Price.
etf_flow_momentum_persistence.interpretation: Persistence matters more than a single daily print.

etf_flow_zscore.what_measures: ETF net flow standardized against its own history.
etf_flow_zscore.price_relation: Highlights unusually large institutional allocation or redemption episodes around Price.
etf_flow_zscore.cross_family_relation: Use with BTC↔ETF divergence and Volatility to judge whether Price is responding normally to the flow.
etf_flow_zscore.interpretation: Large absolute Z-score means unusual capital flow, not guaranteed direction beyond the sign of the flow.

btc_etf_flow_divergence.what_measures: Mismatch between BTC Price direction and ETF capital-flow direction.
btc_etf_flow_divergence.price_relation: Shows when Price and observed ETF allocation are not confirming one another.
btc_etf_flow_divergence.cross_family_relation: CVD/OI can reveal alternative drivers when ETF flow and Price diverge.
btc_etf_flow_divergence.interpretation: Persistent divergence is a structural warning rather than an immediate reversal signal.

exchange_flow_pressure.what_measures: Pressure state from exchange inflow, outflow and net-flow behavior.
exchange_flow_pressure.price_relation: Exchange transfer pressure changes the inventory backdrop around Price but is not executed trade flow.
exchange_flow_pressure.cross_family_relation: Compare with CVD for actual aggression and ETF flows for institutional capital allocation.
exchange_flow_pressure.interpretation: Flow represents movement of BTC inventory; do not infer intent or execution automatically.

exchange_reserve_change.what_measures: Change rate and Z-score of monitored exchange balances/reserves.
exchange_reserve_change.price_relation: Rapid reserve expansion or contraction changes the available inventory context around Price.
exchange_reserve_change.cross_family_relation: On-Chain/Miners can explain supply origins; ETF flow can explain parallel capital demand.
exchange_reserve_change.interpretation: Trend and abnormality matter more than the absolute reserve level alone.

capital_regime_wasserstein.what_measures: Joint ETF/Exchange capital regime plus distributional displacement.
capital_regime_wasserstein.price_relation: Summarizes whether the capital and inventory backdrop around Price is behaving like the reference regime.
capital_regime_wasserstein.cross_family_relation: Useful with Volatility regime shift and Price divergence analysis.
capital_regime_wasserstein.interpretation: Higher displacement indicates a stronger capital-regime transition.

etf_net_flow.title: ETF Net Flow
etf_net_flow.what_measures: Aggregate net allocation into the monitored ETF ecosystem.
etf_net_flow.price_relation: Positive allocation can add demand for BTC exposure but does not mechanically force Price higher.
etf_net_flow.cross_family_relation: Compare with CVD execution and Liquidity to understand transmission into Price.
etf_net_flow.interpretation: Persistent flow matters more than one isolated print.

total_aum.title: Total AUM
total_aum.what_measures: Total assets under management represented by monitored ETF products.
total_aum.price_relation: AUM is a stock/level variable and can change with Price as well as flows.
total_aum.cross_family_relation: Useful as institutional-capital-base context rather than short-term execution flow.
total_aum.interpretation: Do not equate AUM change with ETF net flow.

cumulative_etf_net_flow.title: Cumulative ETF Net Flow
cumulative_etf_net_flow.what_measures: Accumulated ETF net allocation over the selected history.
cumulative_etf_net_flow.price_relation: Shows longer-horizon institutional allocation around Price.
cumulative_etf_net_flow.cross_family_relation: Different from intraday CVD and exchange transfer activity.
cumulative_etf_net_flow.interpretation: Useful for persistent capital trend context.

exchange_inflow.title: Exchange Inflow
exchange_inflow.price_relation: Can increase exchange-side availability but does not prove executed selling or lower Price.
exchange_inflow.cross_family_relation: Compare with Exchange Balance, CVD and Liquidity.
exchange_inflow.interpretation: Transfer is not intent and not execution.

exchange_outflow.title: Exchange Outflow
exchange_outflow.what_measures: BTC transferred away from monitored exchanges.
exchange_outflow.price_relation: Can reduce exchange-side inventory but does not guarantee accumulation or higher Price.
exchange_outflow.cross_family_relation: Compare with reserve trends and ETF demand.
exchange_outflow.interpretation: Transfer is not intent and not execution.

exchange_balance.title: Exchange Balance
exchange_balance.what_measures: Observed BTC inventory held by monitored exchanges.
exchange_balance.price_relation: Inventory expansion or contraction changes the capital/supply context around Price.
exchange_balance.cross_family_relation: Complements Exchange Flow Pressure and On-Chain reserve movement.
exchange_balance.interpretation: Balance is a stock; inflow/outflow are interval flows.

gbtc_premium.title: GBTC Premium / Discount
gbtc_premium.what_measures: Relative pricing of GBTC versus its NAV reference.
gbtc_premium.price_relation: Reflects relative vehicle pricing, not direct Price direction or ETF net flow.
gbtc_premium.interpretation: Premium and discount should not be read as standalone directional signals.

exchange_flow_pressure.title: Exchange Flow Pressure
exchange_flow_pressure.what_measures: Normalized dominance between exchange inflows and outflows.
exchange_flow_pressure.price_relation: Shows transfer-side pressure around Price without claiming execution intent.
exchange_flow_pressure.cross_family_relation: Different from CVD, which observes executed aggressive flow.
exchange_flow_pressure.interpretation: Positive means inflow dominance; negative means outflow dominance under the contract convention.

miner_reserve.price_relation: Changes in miner reserves can alter sell-side treasury pressure on Price.
miner_reserve.cross_family_relation: Connects naturally with ETF demand, exchange balances and liquidity conditions.
miner_reserve.interpretation: Falling reserve often means distribution pressure is rising.

sopr_7d.what_measures: Spent Output Profit Ratio and adjusted variants for miner activity.
sopr_7d.price_relation: Shows whether spent miner-related outputs realize profit or loss around Price.
sopr_7d.cross_family_relation: Complements miner pressure and capitulation regimes.
sopr_7d.interpretation: Values above 1.0 imply realized profit conditions.

hashrate.price_relation: It does not move Price directly, but informs the health and economics behind the mining base.
hashrate.cross_family_relation: Pairs with Difficulty and revenue stress.
hashrate.interpretation: Trend matters more than single prints.

difficulty.price_relation: Affects miner cost pressure and can indirectly influence miner selling behavior that reaches Price.
difficulty.cross_family_relation: Works with Hashrate and Puell Multiple.
difficulty.interpretation: Use jointly with other miner-state variables.

miner_net_position_change.what_measures: Net accumulation or distribution state of miners.
miner_net_position_change.price_relation: Positive NPC can ease sell pressure; negative NPC can increase treasury outflow pressure on Price.
miner_net_position_change.cross_family_relation: Useful with reserve change and miner-to-exchange transfers.
miner_net_position_change.interpretation: It is not the same as one-step reserve change.

miner_reserve_change_zscore.what_measures: Miner reserve change and its standardized abnormality.
miner_reserve_change_zscore.price_relation: Large negative reserve changes can increase miner-side supply pressure on Price.
miner_reserve_change_zscore.cross_family_relation: Exchange flows help identify transfer destinations; Liquidity shows whether that supply is absorbed.
miner_reserve_change_zscore.interpretation: Negative change increases selling-pressure context; it is not identical to Miner Net Position Change.

miner_selling_pressure.what_measures: Composite miner pressure using MPI, miner-to-exchange behavior and reserve reduction.
miner_selling_pressure.price_relation: Higher MSP means the miner complex is exerting stronger potential sell-side pressure around Price.
miner_selling_pressure.cross_family_relation: ETF demand and exchange/liquidity conditions determine whether that pressure is absorbed.
miner_selling_pressure.interpretation: Reserve reduction must increase MSP under the frozen sign convention.

puell_revenue_stress.what_measures: Miner revenue stress using Puell-style economics.
puell_revenue_stress.price_relation: Revenue compression can increase the incentive to monetize treasury, indirectly pressuring Price.
puell_revenue_stress.cross_family_relation: Difficulty, Hashrate and reserve behavior determine whether stress becomes capitulation.
puell_revenue_stress.interpretation: Stress indicates economic pressure, not guaranteed immediate selling.

hashrate_momentum_hash_ribbon.what_measures: Hashrate momentum and Hash Ribbon cycle state.
hashrate_momentum_hash_ribbon.price_relation: Tracks mining-network expansion, compression and recovery that can precede changes in miner behavior affecting Price.
hashrate_momentum_hash_ribbon.cross_family_relation: Combine with Difficulty and Puell stress for miner-cycle confirmation.
hashrate_momentum_hash_ribbon.interpretation: Use as structural cycle context rather than short-term Price timing.

hashrate_difficulty_stress.what_measures: Joint stress between Hashrate behavior and Mining Difficulty.
hashrate_difficulty_stress.price_relation: Higher stress can pressure miner economics and indirectly increase future treasury distribution risk around Price.
hashrate_difficulty_stress.cross_family_relation: Puell and reserve change indicate whether network stress is translating into financial stress.
hashrate_difficulty_stress.interpretation: It is a mining-economics condition, not a direct Price signal.

miner_capitulation_recovery_regime.what_measures: Capitulation/recovery classification supported by distributional regime distance.
miner_capitulation_recovery_regime.price_relation: Identifies when miner state around Price is moving from normal operation into stress or recovery.
miner_capitulation_recovery_regime.cross_family_relation: Volatility and Liquidity help show whether miner regime shifts coincide with broader market stress.
miner_capitulation_recovery_regime.interpretation: Use as a slow structural regime, not as an intraday trigger.

miner_pressure.title: Miner Pressure
miner_pressure.what_measures: Composite pressure state from miner distribution, miner-to-exchange activity and reserve behavior.
miner_pressure.price_relation: Higher pressure can add potential sell-side supply around Price.
miner_pressure.cross_family_relation: Liquidity and ETF demand help determine whether that supply is absorbed.
miner_pressure.interpretation: Pressure is potential distribution context, not proof of immediate selling.

reserve_trend.title: Reserve Trend
reserve_trend.what_measures: Direction of the miner reserve inventory trend.
reserve_trend.price_relation: Persistent reserve decline can increase treasury distribution pressure around Price.
reserve_trend.cross_family_relation: Compare with Net Position and miner-to-exchange activity.
reserve_trend.interpretation: Trend matters more than a single reserve print.

net_position.title: Net Position
net_position.what_measures: Miner net accumulation versus distribution state.
net_position.price_relation: Accumulation can reduce near-term treasury sell pressure; distribution can increase it.
net_position.cross_family_relation: Distinct from one-step reserve change and useful with Exchange Flows.
net_position.interpretation: Positive generally represents accumulation; negative distribution.

sopr_regime.title: SOPR Regime
sopr_regime.what_measures: Profit/loss realization regime of spent outputs used as broader on-chain context.
sopr_regime.price_relation: Profit-taking or loss realization can accompany Price transitions without determining them.
sopr_regime.cross_family_relation: Read with miner pressure, reserve behavior and volatility.
sopr_regime.interpretation: SOPR around 1 is the key neutral reference.

current_regime.price_relation: It describes the risk environment surrounding Price rather than Price direction itself.
current_regime.cross_family_relation: Useful everywhere because volatility changes the interpretation of flow, crowding and liquidity.
current_regime.interpretation: Treat as regime context for the whole platform.

realized_vol_7d.price_relation: Summarizes how much Price has actually moved recently.
realized_vol_7d.cross_family_relation: Compare with implied volatility to understand premium or complacency.
realized_vol_7d.interpretation: Higher values mean realized movement has increased.

implied_vol_dvol.what_measures: Current implied-volatility proxy from options market data.
implied_vol_dvol.price_relation: Represents the volatility that options market participants price into future Price movement.
implied_vol_dvol.cross_family_relation: Contrasts with realized volatility and supports regime interpretation.
implied_vol_dvol.interpretation: Implied volatility is expectation, not realized movement.

vol_risk_premium.what_measures: Gap between implied and realized volatility.
vol_risk_premium.price_relation: Shows whether the options market prices more or less movement than Price has realized.
vol_risk_premium.cross_family_relation: Useful for risk framing across strategies.
vol_risk_premium.interpretation: Positive premium means options imply more movement than realized.

skew_25d.what_measures: 25-delta skew capturing relative demand for downside versus upside optionality.
skew_25d.price_relation: Helps explain whether Price risk is priced more heavily on one tail.
skew_25d.cross_family_relation: Relevant to liquidation and crowding stress.
skew_25d.interpretation: A skew shift changes the risk asymmetry, not spot direction directly.

regime_confidence.what_measures: Confidence score for the current regime assignment.
regime_confidence.price_relation: Higher confidence means the volatility-state interpretation of Price context is more stable.
regime_confidence.cross_family_relation: Useful when weighting the importance of other regime-style families.
regime_confidence.interpretation: Low confidence suggests a transition or ambiguous state.

volatility_zscore_percentile.what_measures: Z-score and percentile of current realized/implied volatility state.
volatility_zscore_percentile.price_relation: Shows how unusual the current Price-movement environment is relative to history.
volatility_zscore_percentile.cross_family_relation: Every flow/positioning family should be interpreted more cautiously when volatility is extreme.
volatility_zscore_percentile.interpretation: High percentile means elevated uncertainty/movement, not direction.

volatility_risk_premium.what_measures: Difference between implied and realized volatility.
volatility_risk_premium.price_relation: Shows whether options price more or less future Price movement than has recently been realized.
volatility_risk_premium.cross_family_relation: OI/Funding and Liquidations help explain why volatility premium may be elevated.
volatility_risk_premium.interpretation: Positive VRP means implied volatility exceeds realized volatility; it does not specify direction.

term_structure_slope.what_measures: Shape and slope of implied volatility across 1W/1M/3M/6M maturities.
term_structure_slope.price_relation: Shows where the market prices future Price uncertainty across time horizons.
term_structure_slope.cross_family_relation: Useful with regime confidence and macro capital-flow shifts.
term_structure_slope.interpretation: Changes in slope can matter even when overall IV level is stable.

volatility_skew_tail_risk.what_measures: 25-delta skew and tail-risk asymmetry in options pricing.
volatility_skew_tail_risk.price_relation: Shows whether downside or upside Price protection carries a larger implied-volatility premium.
volatility_skew_tail_risk.cross_family_relation: Crowding and liquidation risk can reinforce changes in tail pricing.
volatility_skew_tail_risk.interpretation: Skew measures asymmetry of priced risk, not spot direction itself.

vol_of_vol_acceleration.what_measures: Rate of change and acceleration of volatility itself.
vol_of_vol_acceleration.price_relation: A rapid rise means the Price-risk environment is destabilizing, even before absolute volatility reaches an extreme.
vol_of_vol_acceleration.cross_family_relation: Liquidity stress and liquidation cascades often co-move with accelerating volatility.
vol_of_vol_acceleration.interpretation: Acceleration is especially useful for transition detection.

regime_shift_wasserstein.what_measures: Distributional displacement of the volatility regime.
regime_shift_wasserstein.price_relation: Measures how different the current uncertainty environment around Price is from the reference state.
regime_shift_wasserstein.cross_family_relation: Compare with cross-family regime distances in CVD, OI, ETF and Liquidity.
regime_shift_wasserstein.interpretation: Higher distance means stronger regime transition; it is not directional.

realized_volatility.title: Realized Volatility · RV7D / RV30D
realized_volatility.what_measures: Volatility actually realized by Price over short and medium horizons.
realized_volatility.price_relation: Describes the magnitude or pricing of Price uncertainty, not a bullish or bearish direction by itself.
realized_volatility.cross_family_relation: Volatility changes how strongly CVD, OI, Liquidations and Liquidity states should be interpreted.
realized_volatility.interpretation: Focus on level, spread, slope and regime transition rather than directional forecasting.

implied_volatility.title: Implied Volatility · DVOL / IV1M
implied_volatility.what_measures: Volatility priced by the options market rather than already realized by Price.
implied_volatility.price_relation: Describes the magnitude or pricing of Price uncertainty, not a bullish or bearish direction by itself.
implied_volatility.cross_family_relation: Volatility changes how strongly CVD, OI, Liquidations and Liquidity states should be interpreted.
implied_volatility.interpretation: Focus on level, spread, slope and regime transition rather than directional forecasting.

implied_vs_realized.title: Implied vs Realized · VRP
implied_vs_realized.what_measures: Relationship between implied and realized volatility, including the volatility risk premium.
implied_vs_realized.price_relation: Describes the magnitude or pricing of Price uncertainty, not a bullish or bearish direction by itself.
implied_vs_realized.cross_family_relation: Volatility changes how strongly CVD, OI, Liquidations and Liquidity states should be interpreted.
implied_vs_realized.interpretation: Focus on level, spread, slope and regime transition rather than directional forecasting.

term_structure.title: IV Term Structure
term_structure.price_relation: Describes the magnitude or pricing of Price uncertainty, not a bullish or bearish direction by itself.
term_structure.cross_family_relation: Volatility changes how strongly CVD, OI, Liquidations and Liquidity states should be interpreted.
term_structure.interpretation: Focus on level, spread, slope and regime transition rather than directional forecasting.

total_liquidations_24h.what_measures: Total realized liquidations over the last 24 hours.
total_liquidations_24h.price_relation: Represents forced execution pressure that can amplify Price movement.
total_liquidations_24h.cross_family_relation: Connect with OI and crowding to understand why forced flows occurred.
total_liquidations_24h.interpretation: Higher totals mean stronger deleveraging or squeeze activity.

long_liquidations_24h.price_relation: These usually happen when Price falls against leveraged longs.
long_liquidations_24h.cross_family_relation: Useful with downside liquidity and negative flow.
long_liquidations_24h.interpretation: Higher values imply long-side pain dominated.

short_liquidations_24h.price_relation: These usually happen when Price rises against leveraged shorts.
short_liquidations_24h.cross_family_relation: Useful with upside squeeze readings from OI and CVD.
short_liquidations_24h.interpretation: Higher values imply short-side pain dominated.

pressure_score.title: Pressure Score
pressure_score.what_measures: Continuous summary of current liquidation pressure.
pressure_score.price_relation: Higher pressure means forced-flow conditions may amplify Price movement.
pressure_score.cross_family_relation: Liquidity determines how strongly that pressure becomes Price impact.
pressure_score.interpretation: Use the score with its label and dominant side.

long_short_position_ratio.what_measures: Top-position long/short ratio from positioning data.
long_short_position_ratio.price_relation: Shows how directional leverage is positioned around Price.
long_short_position_ratio.cross_family_relation: Positioning is not realized liquidation, but it influences future squeeze risk.

crowding_score.what_measures: Crowding proxy derived from positioning concentration.
crowding_score.price_relation: A crowded market can react sharply when Price moves against it.
crowding_score.cross_family_relation: Relevant to OI, Funding and Liquidations.

current_price.title: Current Price
current_price.what_measures: Current BTC price used as the reference for liquidation maps and cluster distance.
current_price.price_relation: It is the trigger coordinate for vulnerability and realized forced deleveraging.
current_price.cross_family_relation: Shared with Prices and used to measure map proximity.
current_price.interpretation: Use as reference, not a liquidation metric.

realized_imbalance_24h.title: Realized Imbalance 24H
realized_imbalance_24h.what_measures: Long-versus-short composition of realized liquidations over 24 hours.
realized_imbalance_24h.price_relation: Shows which side of leverage was forcibly removed around Price.
realized_imbalance_24h.cross_family_relation: Connect with Price direction, OI contraction and CVD forced flow.
realized_imbalance_24h.interpretation: Positive means long-liquidation dominance under the frozen sign convention.

realized_side_24h.title: Realized Dominant Side 24H
realized_side_24h.what_measures: Classification of which realized liquidation side dominated over the last 24 hours.
realized_side_24h.price_relation: Helps explain whether forced selling or forced buying accompanied Price movement.
realized_side_24h.cross_family_relation: Use with positioning to separate prior crowding from actual forced removal.
realized_side_24h.interpretation: This is realized liquidation side, not the same as positioning dominance.

top_position_ls_ratio.title: Top Position L/S
top_position_ls_ratio.what_measures: Top-position long/short ratio with neutral reference at 1.0.
top_position_ls_ratio.price_relation: Shows positioning imbalance around Price, not realized liquidation.
top_position_ls_ratio.cross_family_relation: Compare with OI/Funding and realized liquidations.
top_position_ls_ratio.interpretation: Above 1 means relatively greater long exposure under this ratio definition.

liquidation_regime.title: Liquidation Regime
liquidation_regime.what_measures: Classification of the current forced-deleveraging environment.
liquidation_regime.price_relation: Summarizes how liquidation pressure is interacting with Price.
liquidation_regime.cross_family_relation: Uses liquidation intensity, crowding, cascade behavior and other family context.
liquidation_regime.interpretation: Treat as a state label, not a forecast.

pressure_label.title: Pressure Label
pressure_label.what_measures: Classification of the continuous liquidation-pressure score.
pressure_label.price_relation: Translates pressure into an interpretable market-state label around Price.
pressure_label.cross_family_relation: Pairs with regime and crowding metrics.
pressure_label.interpretation: Thresholds belong to Classification, not universal trading rules.

dominant_side.title: Dominant Side
dominant_side.what_measures: Current long- or short-dominant positioning state.
dominant_side.price_relation: Shows which side is relatively more exposed around Price.
dominant_side.cross_family_relation: Do not confuse with the side of realized liquidations.
dominant_side.interpretation: Position dominance and liquidation dominance are distinct.

side_imbalance.title: Side Imbalance
side_imbalance.what_measures: Summary positioning-side imbalance preserved separately from realized liquidation imbalance.
side_imbalance.price_relation: Provides directional positioning context around Price.
side_imbalance.cross_family_relation: Read with Top Position L/S and realized liquidation imbalance.
side_imbalance.interpretation: Its sign convention is contract-specific and should not be silently equated to realized liquidation imbalance.

top_exchange_concentration.title: Top Exchange Concentration
top_exchange_concentration.what_measures: Share of realized liquidation activity concentrated in the leading exchange.
top_exchange_concentration.price_relation: High concentration can make Price response more venue-specific.
top_exchange_concentration.cross_family_relation: Useful with cascade and liquidity context.
top_exchange_concentration.interpretation: Near 1 means one venue dominates observed liquidation activity.

max_event_spike.title: Max Event Spike
max_event_spike.what_measures: Largest aggregated liquidation burst within the selected window.
max_event_spike.price_relation: Shows the strongest temporal forced-flow burst affecting Price.
max_event_spike.cross_family_relation: Different from the largest single liquidation event.
max_event_spike.interpretation: Aggregate burst size and single-event size are not the same.

max_single_liquidation.title: Max Single Liquidation
max_single_liquidation.what_measures: Largest individual liquidation event observed in the window.
max_single_liquidation.price_relation: One extreme forced closure can affect Price if liquidity is thin.
max_single_liquidation.cross_family_relation: Compare with Max Event Spike and Liquidity depth.
max_single_liquidation.interpretation: This is one event, not an aggregate temporal burst.

nearest_long_cluster.title: Nearest Long Cluster
nearest_long_cluster.what_measures: Closest estimated long-liquidation concentration to current Price.
nearest_long_cluster.price_relation: Shows nearby downside vulnerability if Price moves into the cluster.
nearest_long_cluster.cross_family_relation: OI and Liquidity help judge how fragile that region is.
nearest_long_cluster.interpretation: A nearby cluster is not a deterministic Price target.

nearest_short_cluster.title: Nearest Short Cluster
nearest_short_cluster.what_measures: Closest estimated short-liquidation concentration to current Price.
nearest_short_cluster.price_relation: Shows nearby upside vulnerability if Price moves into the cluster.
nearest_short_cluster.cross_family_relation: OI and Liquidity help judge squeeze potential.
nearest_short_cluster.interpretation: A nearby cluster is not a deterministic Price target.

liquidation_intensity_zscore.what_measures: Realized liquidation intensity and its Z-score versus recent history.
liquidation_intensity_zscore.price_relation: Extreme intensity means forced execution is unusually strong and can amplify Price movement.
liquidation_intensity_zscore.cross_family_relation: OI/crowding explains the leveraged inventory at risk; Liquidity determines how far Price may travel.
liquidation_intensity_zscore.interpretation: A covered interval with zero events is a valid zero; uncovered data is not.

long_short_liquidation_imbalance.what_measures: Normalized imbalance between realized long and short liquidations.
long_short_liquidation_imbalance.price_relation: Positive means long-liquidation dominance; negative means short-liquidation dominance under the frozen sign convention.
long_short_liquidation_imbalance.cross_family_relation: Price direction distinguishes long flushes from short squeezes; positioning is separate context.
long_short_liquidation_imbalance.interpretation: Do not confuse this realized-liquidation imbalance with summary positioning imbalance.

cascade_acceleration.what_measures: Acceleration of realized liquidation activity through time.
cascade_acceleration.price_relation: Rapid acceleration indicates forced-flow cascades capable of moving Price nonlinearly.
cascade_acceleration.cross_family_relation: Liquidity gaps and rising Volatility can magnify cascade transmission.
cascade_acceleration.interpretation: Acceleration is more informative than total size alone during cascades.

price_liquidation_regime.what_measures: Joint classification of Price behavior and realized liquidation pressure.
price_liquidation_regime.price_relation: Separates states such as long flush, short squeeze and lower-stress movement.
price_liquidation_regime.cross_family_relation: OI/Funding explains prior crowding; CVD shows concurrent aggressive execution.
price_liquidation_regime.interpretation: Use the named regime only when realized liquidation coverage is complete enough.

crowding_liquidation_pressure.what_measures: Interaction between directional positioning crowding and realized liquidation pressure.
crowding_liquidation_pressure.price_relation: Shows when Price is trading against a concentrated leveraged side while forced removal is active.
crowding_liquidation_pressure.cross_family_relation: Bridges OI/Funding positioning with actual realized liquidations.
crowding_liquidation_pressure.interpretation: Crowding is potential fragility; realized liquidations are actual forced execution.

liquidation_regime_hmi.what_measures: Composite liquidation regime/HMI state supported by Wasserstein regime distance.
liquidation_regime_hmi.price_relation: Summarizes whether Price is inside a calm, stressed, cascade or transition environment.
liquidation_regime_hmi.cross_family_relation: Useful with Liquidity and Volatility as a cross-family stress state.
liquidation_regime_hmi.interpretation: Treat as a regime classification, not as a prediction of the next Price move.

aggregate_map.title: Bitcoin Exchange Liquidation Map
aggregate_map.what_measures: Estimated vulnerable liquidation concentrations across observed exchange structure.
aggregate_map.price_relation: Shows potential vulnerability or positioning around Price; it is not realized liquidation unless the panel explicitly says so.
aggregate_map.cross_family_relation: OI/Funding provides leverage context; CVD shows execution; Liquidity determines cascade severity.
aggregate_map.interpretation: Estimated liquidation levels, realized liquidations and positioning are distinct processes.

hyperliquid_map.title: Hyperliquid Liquidation Map
hyperliquid_map.what_measures: Estimated vulnerable liquidation concentrations for Hyperliquid.
hyperliquid_map.price_relation: Shows potential vulnerability or positioning around Price; it is not realized liquidation unless the panel explicitly says so.
hyperliquid_map.cross_family_relation: OI/Funding provides leverage context; CVD shows execution; Liquidity determines cascade severity.
hyperliquid_map.interpretation: Estimated liquidation levels, realized liquidations and positioning are distinct processes.

binance_leverage_map.title: Binance BTC/USDT Liquidation Map
binance_leverage_map.what_measures: Estimated vulnerable liquidation concentrations for Binance BTC/USDT.
binance_leverage_map.price_relation: Shows potential vulnerability or positioning around Price; it is not realized liquidation unless the panel explicitly says so.
binance_leverage_map.cross_family_relation: OI/Funding provides leverage context; CVD shows execution; Liquidity determines cascade severity.
binance_leverage_map.interpretation: Estimated liquidation levels, realized liquidations and positioning are distinct processes.

long_short_positioning.title: Long / Short Positioning
long_short_positioning.what_measures: Global, top-account and top-position long/short ratios with neutral reference at 1.0.
long_short_positioning.price_relation: Shows potential vulnerability or positioning around Price; it is not realized liquidation unless the panel explicitly says so.
long_short_positioning.cross_family_relation: OI/Funding provides leverage context; CVD shows execution; Liquidity determines cascade severity.
long_short_positioning.interpretation: Estimated liquidation levels, realized liquidations and positioning are distinct processes.

bid_depth.what_measures: Visible resting buy-side depth near the market.
bid_depth.price_relation: More bid depth can absorb sell pressure and stabilize Price.
bid_depth.cross_family_relation: CVD tells you the incoming aggression that may consume that depth.
bid_depth.interpretation: Depth can move or disappear; it is not guaranteed support.

ask_depth.what_measures: Visible resting sell-side depth near the market.
ask_depth.price_relation: More ask depth can absorb buy pressure and slow upward Price movement.
ask_depth.cross_family_relation: Combine with large buy execution and liquidations.
ask_depth.interpretation: Heavy ask depth can cap Price until it is consumed or pulled.

spread.what_measures: Distance between best bid and best ask.
spread.price_relation: Wider spread means poorer immediacy and higher friction for Price discovery.
spread.interpretation: A widening spread usually signals worse trading conditions.

liquidity_imbalance.what_measures: Difference between buy-side and sell-side visible depth.
liquidity_imbalance.price_relation: Depth imbalance can bias near-term Price response to incoming execution.
liquidity_imbalance.cross_family_relation: Use with CVD to see whether aggression aligns with resting depth.
liquidity_imbalance.interpretation: It is structural context, not guaranteed direction.

mid_price.what_measures: Midpoint between the best bid and best ask.
mid_price.price_relation: Represents the local reference price inside the order book.
mid_price.cross_family_relation: Large trades and impact are often measured relative to the mid price.

impact_1_btc.what_measures: Estimated price displacement from consuming one BTC of visible liquidity.
impact_1_btc.price_relation: Higher impact means the same executed size can move Price farther.
impact_1_btc.cross_family_relation: CVD measures incoming aggression; Liquidations can add forced execution; Volatility reflects the resulting instability.
impact_1_btc.interpretation: High impact means fragile execution conditions, not a directional forecast.

order_depth.what_measures: Resting order-book depth on both sides of the market.
order_depth.price_relation: Shows where visible liquidity can absorb or resist Price movement.
order_depth.cross_family_relation: Best read with CVD and Large Trades.
order_depth.interpretation: Structure can change quickly, so focus on shape and concentration.

whale_liquidity_profile.what_measures: Large resting liquidity concentrations and their profile.
whale_liquidity_profile.price_relation: Whale orders can attract, repel or magnetize short-term Price action.
whale_liquidity_profile.cross_family_relation: Connect with order-book imbalance and executed pressure.
whale_liquidity_profile.interpretation: Large visible orders matter more when they persist.

executed_liquidity_profile.what_measures: Distribution of unusually large executed trades.
executed_liquidity_profile.price_relation: Large aggressive executions can move Price if liquidity is thin.
executed_liquidity_profile.cross_family_relation: Different from aggregated executed operations and from cumulative delta.
executed_liquidity_profile.interpretation: Treat as event concentration, not a cumulative state.

executed_operations.what_measures: Aggregated aggressive execution interacting with available liquidity.
executed_operations.price_relation: Shows whether actual buy or sell execution is pressing on Price.
executed_operations.cross_family_relation: Executed Operations is not the same as Large Trades and not the same as CVD.
executed_operations.interpretation: Net pressure helps describe the current microstructure impulse.

depth_imbalance_pressure.what_measures: Bid/ask depth asymmetry, depth ratio and normalized pressure.
depth_imbalance_pressure.price_relation: Shows whether resting liquidity structure is more capable of absorbing sell or buy execution around Price.
depth_imbalance_pressure.cross_family_relation: CVD supplies the aggressive flow that interacts with this resting depth.
depth_imbalance_pressure.interpretation: Resting imbalance is not executed-flow imbalance and can change quickly.

spread_market_impact_liquidity_stress.what_measures: Joint spread, market-impact and normalized liquidity-stress state.
spread_market_impact_liquidity_stress.price_relation: Higher spread/impact means a given executed quantity can displace Price farther.
spread_market_impact_liquidity_stress.cross_family_relation: Volatility and Liquidations become more dangerous when liquidity stress is high.
spread_market_impact_liquidity_stress.interpretation: High stress means fragile execution conditions, not directional bias by itself.

liquidity_wall_concentration_vacuum.what_measures: Concentrated bid/ask walls together with upside/downside liquidity vacuums.
liquidity_wall_concentration_vacuum.price_relation: Price may stall near persistent walls and accelerate through thin-liquidity gaps.
liquidity_wall_concentration_vacuum.cross_family_relation: Price support/resistance and CVD help determine whether a wall is being tested or consumed.
liquidity_wall_concentration_vacuum.interpretation: Walls are visible resting liquidity; vacuums describe where depth is absent.

whale_persistence_cancellation.what_measures: Persistence, withdrawal and cancellation behavior of large resting orders.
whale_persistence_cancellation.price_relation: Persistent whale orders can anchor Price; rapid cancellation can remove expected support/resistance.
whale_persistence_cancellation.cross_family_relation: Executed Operations reveal whether aggressive flow actually meets those orders.
whale_persistence_cancellation.interpretation: Behavior is observable; trader intent should not be assumed.

executed_liquidity_absorption.what_measures: Degree to which aggressive executed flow is absorbed by opposing liquidity versus transmitted into Price movement.
executed_liquidity_absorption.price_relation: High absorption means substantial execution produces limited Price displacement; low absorption means flow transmits more efficiently.
executed_liquidity_absorption.cross_family_relation: This explicitly bridges CVD aggression with Order Book/Liquidity response.
executed_liquidity_absorption.interpretation: Executed Operations are aggregate execution; Large Trades remain individual events.

liquidity_regime_hmi.what_measures: Composite liquidity regime/HMI state plus distributional regime displacement.
liquidity_regime_hmi.price_relation: Summarizes whether Price is trading in robust, balanced, fragile or transitionary microstructure conditions.
liquidity_regime_hmi.cross_family_relation: Use with Volatility and Liquidations to assess broader market stress.
liquidity_regime_hmi.interpretation: Liquidity answers what aggressive flow encountered; it is not CVD.
